symptom: Organizations with an unverified legacy Cloud Computer could neither create workspaces nor save or build their recipe, despite fresh builds using a clean stock snapshot.
rule: zstack principles 3, 10 and 13: treat absent historical provenance only as an editable draft for explicit current-authority admission into a new build; retain verified IDs and refuse all historical log, workspace and automatic-refresh backfills. Exercise every manual entry point through the real database and the desktop admission gate.
